name: zerogpu
description: Run AI inference with ZeroGPU's open-weight models and specialized small models.
long_description: Bring a ZeroGPU API key to run OpenAI-compatible inference on open-weight models and ZeroGPU's specialized small language models (ZLMs) for generation, classification and extraction. Saving, replacing and testing a key reads GET /v1/me, which returns the key, project and organization it belongs to; the check is free, runs no inference and does not look at your balance, so a valid key on an account without credit still saves. All forwarded inference is charged to your ZeroGPU account. The gateway keeps the key off your Sprite; the key's own project is used for every request. Supports chat completions and the Responses API, including SSE streaming, plus GET /v1/me. Model listing, embeddings, moderations, audio, batches, files, API-key management, billing and account routes are not forwarded.

messages.400: ZeroGPU rejected the request; check the model ID and request body
messages.402: ZeroGPU balance exhausted; add credits or enable autopay at platform.zerogpu.ai
messages.403: ZeroGPU rejected the API key; check it or create a new one at platform.zerogpu.ai
messages.404: ZeroGPU model not found; check the model ID at docs.zerogpu.ai/docs/model-catalog
messages.429: ZeroGPU rate limit reached; retry after the retry-after interval

presentation.tagline: Open-weight models and specialized small models without storing your ZeroGPU key on a Sprite.
presentation.setup: Log in at platform.zerogpu.ai/dashboard, open API Keys and create a key (it starts with `zgpu-api-`).

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Inference is charged to your ZeroGPU account. Saving, replacing and testing a key read `GET /v1/me`, which is free and does not check your balance; an account without credit saves its key, and inference then returns 402 until you add credit.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `POST /v1/chat/completions` and `POST /v1/responses` (including SSE streaming) and `GET /v1/me` (the key's own key, project and organization IDs) are forwarded. Requests run in the key's own project. Model listing, embeddings, moderations, audio, batches, files, API keys, billing and account routes are not forwarded.
